text:
Ana (CSM): KnoxHealth asked for a short, practical workshop next week: embed quality checks + rollout checklist. Theyre in week 2 onboarding and we'd like to surface adoption signals ahead of a renewal touch in ~5 weeks. Can we do a 75-90m slot?
Marco (Enablement): I can do Mon/Tue mornings PT. Prefer Tue 09:30-11:00 PT for overlap with their UK team.
Rina (SE): Tue 09:30 PT works. Need a 30m preflight with their infra/security lead to validate allowlists and provide a test key.
Sam (Renewals): I'll join for the last 15m to capture adoption metrics and any exec asks. Can we reserve the last 10-15m for renewal notes?
Ana (CSM): Good. sched-bot, can you tentatively block the slot and add a 30m follow-up office hours one week after?
sched-bot: Tentative event created: "KnoxHealth: Embed QA + Rollout Workshop (tentative)" Tue 2026-04-14 09:30-11:00 PT. Follow-up office hours Tue 2026-04-21 09:30-10:00 PT. Invite: https://cal.redwood.ai/event/knox-embed-001
Marco (Enablement): Draft agenda: 10m intros & OKRs, 20m data & metric review, 35m hands-on embed tuning (eval scripts + scoring), 15m rollout + cost ops, 10m renewal flags + next steps.
Rina (SE): Lab requirements: test embeddings key, sample CSV (<=5k rows), pinned model (recommend rwd-7b-embed-int8). Preflight checklist: VPC allowlist, test key, sample data. Posting a small test curl they can run:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_EMBED_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-embed-int8","input":"example patient note"}'
```
Ana (CSM): I asked KnoxHealth to share sample payloads and infra contact by Fri EOD. If not provided, we'll demo on our sanitized sandbox and schedule a follow-up data-validation call.
Sam (Renewals): Flag for the workshop: latency spikes and cost per query. Marco, please include a one-slide "quick wins" cost ops section (batching, cache TTLs).
Marco (Enablement): Adding that. Also will bring a short eval notebook to compute precision-at-k for a small sample set.
Ana (CSM): Any objections to Tue 09:30 PT?
Rina (SE): No objections.
Sam (Renewals): I'll be there.
Marco (Enablement): :thumbsup:
sched-bot: Reminder: preflight checklist due Fri 2026-04-10 17:00 PT.
Ana (CSM): Thanks team I'll update the invite with final agenda and a feedback form once KnoxHealth confirms.
